integrity.proof_type: Finite exact modular enumeration plus explicit cyclotomic construction

scientific_limitations: Specific to the cyclic group of order fifteen and inversion-odd functions. Finite exact modular exclusion requires the accompanying enumerator; explicit cyclotomic witnesses establish existence. No all-composite-order generalization or noise-stability bound. Remaining bibliographic risk: an unindexed equivalent fifteen-cycle sine-matrix classification.
title: Exact equality classes for odd Fourier uncertainty on the fifteen-cycle
